summary.text: Taylor Rehmet is a Democratic member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 9 since February 2026 and is seeking a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election. A U.S. Air Force veteran, he worked as an aircraft machinist and union leader.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Rehmet served in the U.S. Air Force, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes work as an aircraft machinist and union leader, and he has been affiliated with the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers.
Rehmet succeeded Kelly Hancock in Texas State Senate District 9, assuming office on February 19, 2026.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
